name: SlideButton
description: Pill call-to-action whose icon disc slides across the button on hover while the label shifts and the disc rolls a full turn.

ariaRequirements: Renders a real <a href>, so it is focusable and keyboard-activated
The visible label is the accessible name; the icon disc is aria-hidden and decorative
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-07-24 — promotion pass: real <a href> semantics, hover slide/roll gated behind prefers-reduced-motion, forced-colors border/disc/icon fallback, light and dark legibility confirmed in a real browser. AT snapshots captured across base/light/dark/forced-colors.

governance.note: Extracted from DesignSprintsSection's bespoke SprintButton and promoted to stable on first shared use (home DesignSprintsSection + about AboutPageContent). The iconSide axis is geometry-only (mirrored rest/hover positions), modelled as a variant.

content.voice: A short imperative naming the destination, not the gesture.

terminology.rationale: Names where the user lands. The slide is decoration, not meaning.

content.notes: The label is required and is the control's accessible name. The icon disc is decorative.

label.description: Visible, i18n-resolved label. Names the destination, not the gesture.

href.description: Destination. Rendered as a real `<a>`, so it is focusable and keyboard-activated.

icon.description: Phosphor icon name for the sliding disc.

iconSide.description:
Side the icon rests on before it slides across on hover. "left" starts at the
leading edge and travels to the trailing edge; "right" is the mirror.

forbiddenUse: (must): rely on the slide or roll to communicate anything -- both are suppressed under reduced motion, so the label must stand alone.
use it for form submission or in-page actions; reach for `Button` there.
place more than one per view. It is a focal CTA, not a repeated control.
dense: focal pill CTA link; decorative icon disc slides across the pill and rolls on hover; iconSide left/right; motion gated by prefers-reduced-motion; renders a real <a href>

usage.description: SlideButton is a focal pill call-to-action for a single, high-value destination. On hover its icon disc slides across the pill, the label shifts to make room, and the disc rolls a full turn. It renders a real anchor, so it is keyboard-reachable and activates like any link; all motion is suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion.

bestPractices.description: Use it for one focal call-to-action per view, such as the primary next step at the end of a landing section.
Write a label that names the destination, like See the work or Start your sprint, never Click here.
Pick an icon that reinforces the destination; it is decorative and aria-hidden, so it must not be the only thing carrying meaning.
Forward data-* hooks (for example data-donny-interest) through the spread anchor props when a surface needs them.
Do not rely on the slide or roll to communicate anything; both are dropped under reduced motion, so the label must stand alone.
Do not use it for form submission or in-page actions; use Button, which renders a real button.
Do not place more than one per view; it is a focal control, not a repeated action.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.description: Visible text passed as the label prop; it is also the accessible name and names the destination.

anatomy.name: Icon disc
anatomy.description: A coloured disc holding a decorative Phosphor icon; it slides across the pill and rolls on hover.
